text:
maya: quick check — onboarding aurora-lite weights are in s3://redwood-models/aurora-lite/v1/weights.tar.gz. I pushed a new config that toggles prefetch_window_ms to 1200. can folks confirm no tokenizer mismatch?

alex: looking now. what's the tokenizer hash? last time small vocab offset caused off-by-one eos.

sam: tokenizer used by the infra docker is `huggingface/byte-level-bpe:v3`. model metadata says vocab_size=50280. could still be an encoding offset if pos-emb mapping changed.

jing: @maya pushed a config snippet to the onboarding PR — fyi here's the relevant chunk:
```
continuous_batching:
  enabled: true
  adaptive_window_ms: 250
  prefetch_window_ms: 1200
caching:
  kv_cache_prefetch: true
  prefix_cache_ttl_s: 3600
scheduler:
  max_concurrent_streams: 12
  max_tokens_soft_cap: 16384
```

luis: question — prefetch_window_ms 1200 seems high for low-latency usecases. is that only for warmup/large seqs? how does adaptive_window play with it?

maya: good call. plan is: prefetch_window_ms=1200 as a warmup buffer for cold KV caches on first requests, adaptive_window_ms will shrink window if tail latency strict. we can lower prefetch for dedicated (<500).

alex: ran `hf-tokenizer-check` against weights — note: one file `tokenizer.json` has an extra `added_tokens` entry with empty string. that's what caused earlier stray eos. i'll open a small fix PR to strip empty added_tokens.

sam: while you're at it @alex can you add a test to the onboarding harness that runs `encode/decode` roundtrip for 2048 tokens?

alex: yep, will add.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: weights tarball checksum matched. tokenizer schema lint: WARN (empty added_token found). scheduler lint: OK. staging deploy disabled until tokenizer PR merges.

maya: sounds good. next steps: @alex PR + test, @jing make config change to set prefetch_window_ms=600 for dedicated in k8s values, @luis monitor tail latency after warmup and report in ~2h. thanks :thumbsup:
